g.text: Morphology comes with a compression trade-off

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526170

g.text: MorphBPE preserves more automatic reference boundaries while using more tokens per word.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #14283d

g.text: ARCHIVED TRAIN-CORPUS DIAGNOSTIC · NOT HELD-OUT TEST PERFORMANCE

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526170

g.text: Both axes use the same 50,000-document sample (23.04M words). Preservation = 1 − crossed reference boundaries / reference boundaries.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526170

g.text: Reference: automatic TRmorph segmentation; this can favor TRmorph-trained tokenizers and is not independent human annotation.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #526170

g.text: Separate word-level metrics in the report use 200k/500k occurrence caps; those metrics are not plotted here.
